Project Context and Purpose

NCCL provides fast inter-GPU communication for parallel applications.

NVbugs / Jira Tickets

User Experience

NCCL is used through deep learning frameworks or other HPC applications to accelerate GPU-to-GPU communication. It is supposed to be transparent to the user.
